Petroleum Resources
to  require  a  contractor  to  whom  a  Exploration
Licence,  a  Development  Licence  or  a  Unit
Development Licence as the case may be has been
issued, by notice in writing, to furnish such return
or information as the Authority considers necessary
for the due discharge of its functions;
to  measure  quantities  of  petroleum  resources
recovered in Sri Lanka and to take samples thereof;
to  approve  the  annual  work  programmes  and
budgets  submitted  by  contractors  in  terms  of  a
Petroleum Resources Agreement;
to discharge all regulatory functions relating to any
Petroleum Resources Agreement;
to charge fees or any other payments for any services
provided by the Authority;
to  retain  consultants  and  expert  advisors,  when
necessary,  subject  to  the  approval  of  the  Board,
and implement such capacity building measures as
are necessary; and
to  conduct  activities  which  are  necessary  for,  or
conducive or incidental to, the carrying out of the
functions of the Authority.
